subject.title: fix(agents): avoid symlink-follow in auth.json bootstrap

question: Should the no-final-path-chmod and exact-mode behavior remain in OpenClaw's shared replace-file wrapper for this PR, or should it move into @openclaw/fs-safe before merge?
rationale: The diff changes a security-sensitive helper exported through the plugin SDK, and automation cannot choose the permanent owner boundary for that dependency contract.

options.title: Approve Wrapper Ownership
options.body: Keep the current OpenClaw wrapper-level fix, treating the added mode, fallback, and queued-write tests as the compatibility proof for this PR.

options.title: Move Into fs-safe First
options.body: Patch or update @openclaw/fs-safe so the dependency owns no-follow-safe exact-mode replacement, then thin OpenClaw's wrapper back down.

options.title: Narrow To Auth Bootstrap
options.body: Land only the auth.json bootstrap route through atomic replacement and track shared replacement-wrapper hardening separately.

recommendation.title: Approve Wrapper Ownership
recommendation.body: Keep the current OpenClaw wrapper-level fix, treating the added mode, fallback, and queued-write tests as the compatibility proof for this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent is the clearest listed Agents/Security routing owner for the secops boundary decision, while CODEOWNERS routes the auth-sensitive file to the secops team.
